AURUM Series is a high performance line-up of FSP Power Supply family with 80 PLUS Gold Certification (>90% efficiency). AURUM Series combines premium quality and efficiency, making it the most ideal choice for those who seek for high performance, reliability and quality at the same time. With FSP in house design and patented MIA IC technology, AURUM series power supply not only smaller in size but also offer best performance and protection to your system. AURUM comes with arrow-shaped ventilation to provide remarkable air ventilation and super cooling performance. AURUM’s sleek design and unique rugged Granite-Touch finishing makes it a Power Supply you can count on for years to come.

For those of you that are active power users, system builders, and performance enthusiasts, FSP AURUM GOLD 400 is your ideal solution for your next PC build or current PC upgrade.
